messages:
anya: heads-up — noticing error surge and 5xxs from the prompt-gateway after the v2 deploy, canary traffic shows latency jumps ~3x. rolling back in progress? :rotating_light:

sre-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: prompt-gateway-v2 canary latency > 2000ms, error rate 8% (baseline ~0.2%). paging oncall: @mike_oncall. automated mitigation suggestions: evaluate routing flag or abort canary.

mike_oncall: on it. switching to on-call context, grabbing logs. anyone seen hotfix or traffic shift configs?

anya: deploy-bot showed canary split 10% -> 50% at 1918273600, but the new prompt-routing variant is dropping connections to the external tokenizer service. stack traces point at grpc timeout.

carla_pm: customer-impact check — CSMs reporting higher latencies for power-users, one active trial impacted. no billing loss yet but UX is degraded. priority: stop further rollout.

dave_infra: I can flip the routing flag to force traffic back to prompt-gateway-stable. quick command below (will run if we get consensus):

```bash
# toggle feature flag in LaunchDarkly via CLI
ldctl feature-flag set prompt.routing.v2 false --env production --actor mike_oncall
```

mike_oncall: do it. add a short TTL so we can re-enable after triage. also want to scale the stable pool to absorb 50% traffic — @dave_infra please scale +2 pods.

dave_infra: scaling stable pool now (k8s). running: `kubectl scale deployment/prompt-gateway-stable --replicas=12 -n prod` — will monitor CPU/latency.

sre-bot: ACTION: feature_flag_toggle initiated by mike_oncall at 1918273721. Flag `prompt.routing.v2` -> false. Fallthrough routing: prompt-gateway-stable.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered: prompt-gateway-v2 rollout halted and rollout status: aborted. new canary target: stable (pinned).

anya: observing error rate dropping back toward baseline within a minute. latency trending down. verifying traces for failed GRPC calls — marking incident mitigated for now.

carla_pm: filing customer comms draft for affected trial: short note + apology + remediation ETA. handing to @customer_success to send.

customer_success: will prepare and send in 15m, will include rollback confirmation and short timeline.

ops_lead: good call. assign a short RCA and flagship postmortem: owners — infra (dave_infra) + runtime (anya). add follow-up items: improved canary throttles, automated preflight for external service timeouts, stricter kill-switch playbook.

mike_oncall: closing the active page. create incident ticket `INC-2026-5432` and assign to owners. if any regressions, reopen. :thumbsup:

anya: noted — saving logs and traces, will push a runbook PR with the rollback commands used and the precise LD toggle sequence. thanks all for the fast turnaround.

sre-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: prompt-gateway-v2 canary aborted, traffic routed to stable. mitigation window: 1918273721 -> 1918273889. postmortem pending.
